summary: International Land Alliance Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Securities Purchase Agreement with an accredited investor, issuing a convertible promissory note with up to $385,000 principal (including $35,000 original discount, 10% interest, 12-month maturity) and a warrant to purchase 48,125 shares at $10.00 per share over five years. The note converts at the lower of $6.00 per share or 65% of the lowest traded price over 20 days before conversion. This is a routine capital-raising financing arrangement, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring; the filing does not indicate any strategic review, activist campaign, or corporate control change. What to watch: no risk-arb angle exists as this is not a merger or tender offer.
